'''Elvarnos''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the continent of [[Keshtah Minor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It survived through the [[Great Crisis]], and held archives of information on the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], including
the final testament of [[Yaru Korsin]].
